paragraphs: Use the calendar and scales to compare crops and plan their care.

pages.eyebrow: HOW TO USE THIS BOOK · CONTINUED

calendar.heading: Reading the calendar
paragraphs: Bright shades show the usual sowing and harvest months for temperate climates: here, lowland England (US zones 8 to 9). Muted shades show less usual options for warmer climates. Use local conditions and the crop’s advice to choose your timing.

image.alt: Growing calendar captured from the Radish guide, showing bright usual months and muted less usual months
English ploughed field with a sun

scales.heading: Difficulty rating
paragraphs: Difficulty reflects ease of growing and tolerance of adverse conditions. Radishes suit beginners; celery and cauliflower can defeat even experienced gardeners in a bad season.

image.alt: Difficulty badge captured from the Broccoli guide: Medium, 3 out of 5
Baby looking at a healthy growing plant

scales.heading: Core needs
paragraphs: Too little sun, water or manure can damage some plants, while too much can harm others. Use the scales as a guide to each crop’s needs.

image.alt: Core Needs captured from Radish: Sun and Nutrition faded, Water highlighted at 4 out of 5
